shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'next.config.*' -g 'tsconfig.json' -g 'pages/**' -g 'src/pages/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'src/app/**' -g 'node_modules/next/dist/docs/**' | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc "for f in pages/index.js pages/blog/index.js 'pages/blog/[id].js' pages/api/posts/index.js 'pages/api/posts/[id].js' pages/_error.js pages/_document.js pages/_app.js pages/404.js; do printf '\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,240p'"
/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && cat tsconfig.json && cat next.config.ts && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/02-project-structure.md && sed -n '1,300p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/03-layouts-and-pages.md && sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/05-server-and-client-components.md && sed -n '1,300p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md && sed -n '1,300p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/15-route-handlers.md && sed -n '1,300p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/14-metadata-and-og-images.md && sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/10-error-handling.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!'"\\.git/**' && printf '\\n--- Pages APIs and routes references ---\\n' && rg -n \"next/(head|router|document)|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|next/router|pages/|/api/posts|fetch\\(\" -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!'"\\.git/**'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat components/AppProvider.js && sed -n '1,280p' styles/globals.css && rg -n \"generateStaticParams|revalidate|cacheComponents|cacheLife|fetch\\(\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/09-revalidating.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/18-upgrading.md | sed -n '1,240p' && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/15-route-handlers.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,250p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/caching-without-cache-components.md && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/03-layouts-and-pages.md && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/05-server-and-client-components.md && sed -n '1,190p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md && rg -n \"generateStaticParams|dynamicParams|revalidate\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/file-conventions/route-segment-config.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/functions/generate-static-params.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/file-conventions/page.md"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference -type f | rg 'not-found|file-conventions/(layout|error|page)|generate-static-params|headers|route' | sed -n '1,120p' && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/file-conventions/not-found.md && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/file-conventions/error.md && sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/functions/headers.md && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/functions/generate-static-params.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/not-found.md && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md && sed -n '1,170p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/headers.md && sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/generate-static-params.md && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/page.md && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/layout.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"reset:|retry:\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md | sed -n '1,100p' && rg -n \"interface ErrorProps|retry\\?:|reset\\?:\" node_modules/next/dist -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,140p'"
/bin/bash -lc 'mv components/AppProvider.js components/AppProvider.tsx'

/bin/bash -lc "find pages -print 2>/dev/null; rg --files -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!'"\\.git/**' | sort; git status --short; rg -n \"next/(head|router|document)|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|next/router\" -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!'"\\.git/**' || true"

/bin/bash -lc "rmdir pages/api/posts pages/api pages/blog pages && git diff --stat && git diff -- package.json && git diff -- app lib components styles/globals.css | sed -n '1,320p' && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc './node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit'
/bin/bash -lc './node_modules/.bin/next typegen'

/bin/bash -lc "./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit && git diff -- tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,220p' components/AppProvider.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' lib/blog.ts && sed -n '1,240p' app/blog/'[id]'/page.tsx && sed -n '1,220p' app/api/posts/route.ts && sed -n '1,220p' app/api/posts/'[id]'/route.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files app components lib && rg -n \"next/(head|router|document)|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|router\\.isFallback|className=\\\"button\\\"\" app components lib styles -g '"'!*.css'"' && sed -n '1,220p' app/layout.tsx && sed -n '1,180p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,180p' app/blog/page.tsx && sed -n '1,200p' app/error.tsx && sed -n '1,200p' app/global-error.tsx && sed -n '1,100p' tsconfig.json && git diff --check && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc "cat .gitignore && find .next -maxdepth 4 -type f | sed -n '1,60p' && ls -la next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo"
/bin/bash -lc 'find .next -type f -delete && find .next -depth -type d -empty -delete'
/bin/bash -lc "find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'next-env.d.ts' -delete && find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo' -delete"

/bin/bash -lc 'test ! -e pages && echo '"'pages directory removed'; rg -n \"next/(head|router|document)|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps\" -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!'"\\.next/**' -g '"'!'"\\.git/**' || true; git diff --check; git status --short"
